note: Three gravel back-in sites around one small clearing off Shaggers Inn Road, each with a picnic table and 30 ft of overhead clearance; the booking page lists the driveways as a moderate grade. 001 is the open one (120 by 50 ft, not under trees); 002 and 003 are long narrow pads under trees, 120 by 12 ft at the end of 150-ft driveways. The agency's directions come from PA 153 by Four Mile Road (4.1 miles) and McGeorge Road (4.7 miles), right on Caledonia Pike for 0.3 mile, then left on Shaggers Inn Road for about 0.4 mile. No toilet; drinking water is more than a quarter mile away. Pack out trash. --Claude
